_what: The eight custom roles terraform/infra and its modules defined on origin/main at 89f2e09, before they moved to terraform/bootstrap (#79). Captured from the live project with read-only `gcloud iam roles describe <id> --project saga-agents-staging --format=json` on 2026-09-25 at 08:52 UTC; tests/terraform/platform_roles_fixture.tftest.hcl held these values to origin/main's module definitions in CI before the move, and tests/terraform/platform_roles.tftest.hcl holds terraform/bootstrap to them after it. Permissions sorted. Do not edit this to match a changed role: a permission change is a separate, owner-applied decision, and this file is the record of what the move had to preserve.

job_dispatcher.title: Swarm Job Dispatcher
job_dispatcher.description: Create and run Cloud Run Job resources. No delete, no IAM, no services.

job_reaper.title: Swarm Job Reaper
job_reaper.description: Cancel and delete executions, garbage-collect unused Job resources. Reconciler only.

gke_dispatcher.title: Swarm GKE Dispatcher
gke_dispatcher.description: Create and observe Jobs on the swarm Autopilot cluster. No Secret access, no cluster mutation.

gke_reaper.title: Swarm GKE Reaper
gke_reaper.description: Delete finished Jobs and stuck Pods on the swarm Autopilot cluster. Reconciler only.

secret_lister.title: Swarm Secret Lister and Account Provisioner
secret_lister.description: List secret metadata project-wide, and create the two secrets an account pool entry needs. Cannot read any payload.

worker_firestore.title: Swarm Tenant Worker Firestore
worker_firestore.description: Read and write control-plane documents by id. No deletes, no queries.

bucket_metadata_reader.title: Swarm Bucket Metadata Reader
bucket_metadata_reader.description: storage.buckets.get only. Enough to mount, not enough to enumerate.

image_puller.title: Swarm Image Puller
image_puller.description: Pull an image by a name already held. Cannot enumerate the repository, cannot push.
